item.title: Program Trading - CTP
item.description: 1. Introduction to the Comprehensive Trading Platform (CTP) The Comprehensive Trading Platform is a futures brokerage business management system developed by Shanghai Futures Information Technology Co., Ltd. for futures brokerage firms, based on the trading system of the Shanghai Futures Exchange. The whole system consists of three major subsystems: trading, risk control (abbreviated as risk control) and settlement.
